HOW TO ADD A DROPDOWN (SELECT) FIELD - MANUAL, NO forms.py
==============================================================

No form.py, no {{ form.field }}. Just plain HTML + view code.


TYPE 1: Fixed choices (list of options) ====== meka eachchara en na.
--------------------------------------------------------------
Example: Payment status dropdown.

1) View - send the choices list to the template:
    return render(request, 'your_template.html', {
        'status_choices': Payment.STATUS_CHOICES,
    })

2) Template - build the <select>:
    <select name="status" id="status" class="form-control">
        {% for value, label in status_choices %}
        <option value="{{ value }}" {% if value == obj.status %}selected{% endif %}>{{ label }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
    </select>

3) View - read the picked value on POST:
    status = request.POST.get('status')


TYPE 2: Choices from a database table ============= Most used.
--------------------------------------------------------------
Example: Medicine dropdown on Add Stock page.

1) View - send the list of rows:
    return render(request, 'your_template.html', {
        'medicines': Medicine.objects.all(),
    })

2) Template - build the <select>:
    <select name="medicine" id="medicine" class="form-control">
        <option value="">---------</option>
        {% for item in medicines %}
        <option value="{{ item.pk }}" {% if item.pk == batch.medicine_id %}selected{% endif %}>{{ item.name }}</option>
        {% endfor %}
    </select>

3) View - read the picked value on POST:
    medicine_id = request.POST.get('medicine')
    medicine = get_object_or_404(Medicine, pk=medicine_id)


NOTE
--------------------------------------------------------------
"selected" shows the current value on Edit pages. On Add pages there
is no current value yet, so nothing is pre-selected.
